description:
As a Payroll Clerk, produce the monthly attendance summary for payroll reconciliation. Generate a TimeSheet Summary report in TimeTrex covering February 1, 2026 to February 28, 2026 for all employees. Export the report as a CSV file and save it to the Desktop as 'attendance_feb2026.csv'.

The report must include actual timesheet data — do not save an empty file. The file must be saved to /home/ga/Desktop/attendance_feb2026.csv.
